long_biography.plain_text:
Rodney Ray Lewis was born in St. Louis and grew up in Laredo, Texas, where he completed a criminal-justice degree at what is now Texas A&M International University. He entered the energy industry as a well gauger, learning field operations before buying a producing natural-gas well. In 1983 he founded Lewis Petro Properties, the business that became Lewis Energy Group.

Lewis built the company around exploration and production in South Texas, adding drilling, pipeline and other supporting operations. It became an important operator in the Eagle Ford region and also developed projects in Mexico and Colombia. Lewis remained chief executive as the group expanded internationally. His career is defined by hands-on field experience, founder ownership and long-term development of natural-gas acreage and infrastructure.
